Sandbox_PLS_TrackZombieKills_tooltip: Scores every zombie a player kills and shows a Zombie Kills board.
Sandbox_PLS_TrackZombieKillsPerLife_tool: Adds a Per Life tab to the Zombie Kills board, ranking the most zombies anyone has killed on a single life. The record stands after the death that ended the run. Needs Track Zombie Kills on as well.
Sandbox_PLS_TrackPlayerKills_tooltip: Scores player-versus-player kills and shows a Player Kills board. Off by default.
Sandbox_PLS_TrackPlayerKillsPerLife_tool: Adds a Per Life tab to the Player Kills board, ranking the most players anyone has killed on a single life. The record stands after the death that ended the run. Needs Track Player Kills on as well.
Sandbox_PLS_AnnounceFirstPlace_tooltip: Tells the whole server in chat when a board's first place changes hands.
Sandbox_PLS_PvpPairCooldownMinutes_toolt: Real minutes before killing the same player again counts. Stops two accounts trading kills to climb the Player Kills boards. (0-120)
Sandbox_PLS_AnnounceCooldownMinutes_tool: Real minutes to wait between announcements on the same board, so two players trading the lead cannot flood chat. (0-120)
Sandbox_PLS_AnnounceUpsets_tooltip: Tells the whole server when someone kills the player at the top of a Per Life board, and when a run good enough to place in the top three ends in a horde. Reads the Per Life boards only, so it does nothing if both of those are switched off.
Sandbox_PLS_AnnounceUpsetCooldownMinutes: Real minutes before the same player is worth announcing again, so somebody hunting the same champion cannot flood chat. Two different players falling in the same minute are still two announcements. (0-120)
Sandbox_PLS_BoardSize_tooltip: How many ranks the server sends to each client. Players outside this still see their own standing. (3-50)
Sandbox_PLS_MinScoreToRank_tooltip: A player needs at least this much to appear on a board, so the list is not padded with everyone sitting on nothing. (1-1000)
Sandbox_PLS_BackupEnabled_tooltip: Off by default. Scores live in the world save, which means a server that is killed instead of shut down loses them, and a rollback takes them with it. Turn this on to also write a plain JSON copy to the Zomboid/Lua folder, outside the save, on every world save and shutdown. Nothing is ever loaded back on its own - an admin restores it with /pls restore.
Sandbox_PLS_IgnoreDebugKills_tooltip: Off by default, so every kill counts. Turn it on to keep kills made in debug mode off the boards, for staff who spawn things in to test them. Only an admin account can join in debug mode at all, and the client reports its own mode, so this is a courtesy rather than anti-cheat. Everyone else scores either way.
